question: Should session-memory now treat duplicate `gateway-injected` rows the same as duplicate `delivery-mirror` rows when the sanitized text repeats the previous visible assistant reply?
rationale: This is a small bug fix, but it intentionally changes which persisted transcript-only assistant rows are recalled into memory files, and that session-state projection choice needs maintainer ownership before merge.

options.title: Accept the broader duplicate filter
options.body: Land the PR after exact-head gates pass, accepting that identical transcript-only `gateway-injected` rows are bookkeeping duplicates for session-memory purposes.

options.title: Keep the current narrower filter
options.body: Close or reject this direction if session-memory must preserve every `gateway-injected` row even when it repeats the previous visible assistant text.

options.title: Ask for narrower production proof
options.body: Hold the PR for a real captured transcript showing duplicate `gateway-injected` rows from the affected runtime path before accepting the projection change.

recommendation.title: Accept the broader duplicate filter
recommendation.body: Land the PR after exact-head gates pass, accepting that identical transcript-only `gateway-injected` rows are bookkeeping duplicates for session-memory purposes.
